run_opentuner_ga: run opentuner_ga to optimize an LLVM environment using a genetic algorithm with configurable search time and population
create_LlvmOptFlagsTuner: create a LlvmOptFlagsTuner instance to define the search space for LLVM opt pass flag autotuning
run_LlvmOptFlagsTuner_manipulator: run the LlvmOptFlagsTuner manipulator method to get a ConfigurationManipulator with biased random pass selection
run_LlvmOptFlagsTuner_serialize_actions: run serialize_actions on LlvmOptFlagsTuner to convert a search space config into an ordered list of opt actions
run_LlvmOptFlagsTuner_run: run the LlvmOptFlagsTuner run method to evaluate a single configuration by executing LLVM opt and measuring the result
